name: Ichinose Shinogu
source:
The singer in the band, A member of a neighboring class.
He's always surrounded by lots of girls.
He has a frivolous personality, but he always takes his band duties seriously.
There's lots of girls whose hearts have been stolen away after seeing him singing.
